Same as ava_cli build's --force-so: rebuilds/relinks libavalang.so (the AvaLang
runtime, cross-compiled) instead of reusing the one already sitting next to
--out. Needed the first time you build into a clean output folder, or after
changing runtime/avalang/.

Same as ava_cli build's --force-runtime: rebuilds avapack_barekernel_runtime
(main_barekernel.cpp) instead of reusing the cached .a in
build_pack_barekernel/. Needed the first time you build into a clean repo
checkout, or after changing main_barekernel.cpp / app.ld.
Remember to turn this back off after your next build -- left on, every build force-rebuilds and loses the caching speedup.
